name: cookie-sentinel
description: Audit Set-Cookie headers for security issues: missing Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite, __Host-/__Secure- prefix violations, broad Domain/Path, long expiry, cookies over HTTP, oversized cookies, JWTs and emails in values, duplicates and Partitioned misuse, with a fix for each. Follows redirects, supports auth headers and offline input. Text, JSON, SARIF, Markdown; GitHub Action included. Zero dependencies.
author: Louis Wright <hello@louiswright.co.uk> (https://github.com/MrLouisWright)
